conclusion: No significant difference between broad (67 factors incl rule_score) and no-rule (65 factors). p=0.71, CI spans zero widely [-26, +41 bps]. rule_score contributes weak negative IC (-0.032) and is consistently selected but marginal value is statistically indistinguishable from noise.
recommendation: rule_score is NOT harmful but provides no measurable alpha lift. The 33-factor baseline (Sharpe -0.113) outperforms both broad (-0.125) and no-rule (-0.301), suggesting adding low-quality factors dilutes signal. Retain rule_score in candidate pool but prioritize factor quality over quantity.
